title: Stock library manifest
description: Schema for backend/data/stock-library/manifest.json (brief docs/briefs/stock-library-builder.md §6). The manifest itself lives with the assets and is gitignored; this schema is committed so the shape is reviewable without the binaries. Provenance fields are mandatory: the attribution discipline that applies to charts applies to footage.

id.description: Class-scoped, zero-padded, never reused. e.g. ports-0003

providerId.description: Provider's own id. (provider, providerId) is the dedupe key.

creator.description: Attribution. Null only where the provider returned none.

sourceUrl.description: The clip's page on the provider — mandatory.

license.description: Licence as named by the provider, e.g. 'Pexels License'.

cropGrade.description: The §5 grade. soft-hd-crop is rationed per class and flagged for curation.

filePath.description: Relative to the library root, e.g. staging/ports-0003.mp4. Never absolute — the library is relocatable.

treatedPath.description: Relative path to the graded rendition, or null before treatment. The source download is never overwritten.

status.description: staged → (kept | rejected, set by a human) → treated. A rejected row is KEPT so re-acquire does not re-download it, even though its file is deleted.
